start.title: Desde la distancia
start.text:
Las antorchas llevan a Jesús encadenado.
Tu corazón late con fuerza. ¿Te atreves a seguirle?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Run home and hide your shame

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] This hour is not for swords.

hide_consequence.title: No abandones
hide_consequence.text:
Él necesita un testigo, no el abandono.
Vuelve a Su sombra.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn back into the night.

charge_consequence.title: No por la fuerza
charge_consequence.text:
Él te dijo que guardaras la espada.
Síguele suavemente, no con furia.

gate.title: La puerta exterior
gate.text:
Juan habla con el portero por ti.
La puerta se abre con un crujido a la luz del fuego.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lie about your name at once

boast_consequence.title: Todavía no, Pedro
boast_consequence.text:
La jactancia una vez te costó todo.
Entra humildemente esta noche.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You step softly past the gate.

lie_consequence.title: Silencio sobre las mentiras
lie_consequence.text:
Una mentira siempre pide otra.
Entra sin decir palabra.

courtyard_fire.title: Entre los guardias
courtyard_fire.text:
El frío te muerde las manos. Un fuego crepita.
Guardias y sirvientes se calientan.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your face still catches the glow.

joke_consequence.title: Así no
joke_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your loud voice will undo you.
Quiet your heart instead.

pray_path.title: [TODO:es] A Whispered Prayer
pray_path.text:
[TODO:es] You ask for strength you do not feel.
A servant girl steps closer.

first_recognized.title: [TODO:es] You Were With Him
first_recognized.text:
[TODO:es] A servant girl says, "You were with
the Galilean. I know your face."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your stomach turns at your words.
[TODO:es] Truth would have set you free.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Glare at her in furious silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Silence here is its own denial.

confess_consequence.title: [TODO:es] If You Had Spoken
confess_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The harder road would have held you.
But fear pulls another way.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The lie slips out before you stop it.

glare_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Words Spill Out
glare_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your silence draws more eyes than words.
Fear loosens your tongue.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The first denial leaves your lips.

second_recognized.title: [TODO:es] Another Voice
second_recognized.text:
[TODO:es] Another servant points: "This one too
was with Jesus of Nazareth."

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice trembles with the lie.
[TODO:es] Truth would still spare your soul.

walk_back_consequence.title: [TODO:es] More Eyes Turn
walk_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Returning only sharpens the questions.
The lie is already on your lips.

admit_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Fear Wins Again
admit_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Truth shines for a moment in your heart.
Then fear smothers it.

third_accusation.title: [TODO:es] Your Accent Betrays You
third_accusation.text:
[TODO:es] A man insists: "Surely you are one.
Your Galilean speech gives you away."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your own oath cuts the night.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "I am His. Strike me if you must."
[TODO:es] Flee through the gate at once

courage_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Fear Speaks Louder
courage_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Courage flickers, then fades to ash.
The oath rises up instead.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:es] The Door Is Closed
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Guards block the gate behind you.
Only your tongue can buy escape now.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse and swear, "I never knew him!"

rooster.title: [TODO:es] A Rooster Crows
rooster.text:
[TODO:es] Far off, a rooster splits the dark.
Across the court, His eyes find yours.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Look away and pretend not to see
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His gaze has already pierced you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Shout that it is not your fault
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Only honest grief can heal this.

lookaway_consequence.title: [TODO:es] He Sees You Anyway
lookaway_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] No shadow can hide you from love.
Let His look reach you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His eyes are sorrow, not scorn.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stop the Shouting
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Excuses cannot hold the truth back.
Only tears can.

weeping.title: [TODO:es] Out Into the Night
weeping.text:
[TODO:es] "Before the rooster crows, you will
deny me three times." You remember.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Harden your heart and walk on
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A broken heart is the doorway.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Blame the guards for the lie
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Only your own heart can answer.

harden_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Let the Tears Come
harden_consequence.text:
Un corazón endurecido no puede ser perdonado.
Uno roto ya lo está.

blame_consequence.title: Asume el fracaso
blame_consequence.text:
La culpa es tuya. La misericordia la espera.
Llévala honestamente a la noche.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You step into the cold and weep.

ending.title: Lágrimas amargas
ending.text:
Más allá de la puerta caes de rodillas.
La misericordia te encontrará aquí, incluso ahora.
